issue_request: FHIR-20191 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Device request asking whether Device.manufacturer and Device.deviceName.name with type manufacturer-name were duplicates, and requesting clarification if they were not.
initial_application: The Device updates merged by HL7/fhir#802, including commit a7f2575daa, listed FHIR-20191 among preapplied Device changes. Later FHIR-20639 commits changed the relevant Device name type definitions and removed manufacturer-name.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has Device.name instead of Device.deviceName, Device.name.type is bound to the Device Name Type value set, and its current CodeSystem has registered-name, commercial-brand-family, user-friendly-name, and patient-reported-name but no manufacturer-name. FHIR-20639, FHIR-39162, and FHIR-47605 are later applied Device naming decisions that shape the current source.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is needed because adding the original Acme/Pulse-Ox prose would restate a distinction already conveyed by current source and would reference an obsolete code.
